boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten campus-specific places documented by UH Mānoa as study, break, recreation, or student-life spaces.

cards.title: Set up at Hamilton’s Bridge Area
cards.subtitle: Hamilton Library, first-floor bridge
cards.notes: Use the bridge-area tables, booths, or soundproof booths when your group needs room to spread out between classes.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor library zone with collaborative seating, booths, and soundproof booths.
cards.evidence_claim: UH Mānoa Libraries identifies the Bridge Area as a first-floor study area with collaborative seating, group-study booths, and soundproof booths.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces — University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa Library
cards.access_notes: Located in Hamilton Library near the first-floor bridge connecting the Main Building and Addition.

cards.title: Work together in the Sunny Alcove
cards.subtitle: Hamilton Library, first floor
cards.notes: Choose this window-lit alcove for a collaborative session, especially when your work benefits from large tables and standing desks.
cards.short_summary: A naturally lit first-floor alcove configured for collaborative work.
cards.evidence_claim: UH Mānoa Libraries describes the Sunny Alcove as a first-floor collaborative study space with natural light, large tables, and standing desks.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces — University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa Library
cards.access_notes: On the first floor of Hamilton Library’s Main Building.

cards.title: Use a workstation at the CLIC Lab
cards.subtitle: Hamilton Library, first floor
cards.notes: Head here when your assignment needs campus computers, Microsoft Office, scanning, or a reliable workstation rather than a laptop-only seat.
cards.short_summary: A Hamilton Library computer lab with approximately 80 Dell computers and scanning.
cards.evidence_claim: UH Mānoa Libraries says the CLIC Lab has approximately 80 Dell computers with Microsoft Office and is open to UH students, faculty, and staff.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces — University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa Library
cards.access_notes: Open to University of Hawaiʻi students, faculty, and staff; located on Hamilton Library’s first floor.

cards.title: Drop into the CNS Student Academic Success Center
cards.subtitle: Hamilton Library, Room 002K
cards.notes: Use the ground-floor center when you want seating and charging near the library; confirm program help or availability before relying on it.
cards.short_summary: A ground-floor Hamilton Library student space with seating and charging outlets.
cards.evidence_claim: UH Mānoa’s College of Natural Sciences lists the CNS Student Academic Success Center in Hamilton Library Room 002K with seating and charging outlets.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces — University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa College of Natural Sciences
cards.access_notes: Located on the ground floor of Hamilton Library in Room 002K.

cards.title: Pause at the Campus Center
cards.subtitle: Campus Center Complex
cards.notes: Use the seating between classes, then check the complex’s current events or services before heading to your next commitment.
cards.short_summary: The central student-union building for dining, events, services, and between-class study.
cards.evidence_claim: UH Mānoa identifies the Campus Center Complex as its student union and says students can attend events, study between classes, and access dining and services there.
cards.source_title: Campus Center Complex — Student Life & Development
cards.access_notes: The Campus Center is part of the Campus Center Complex; building hours vary by term and are posted by Student Life.

cards.title: Move between classes at Warrior Recreation
cards.subtitle: Campus Center Complex
cards.notes: Use the indoor track, fitness equipment, or scheduled classes for a study break; check eligibility and the current recreation schedule first.
cards.short_summary: A multi-level campus gym with an indoor track, fitness options, and classes.
cards.evidence_claim: UH Mānoa describes the Warrior Recreation Center as a multi-level gym where students can use the indoor track, take classes, and lift weights.
cards.source_title: Student Co-Curricular Success — University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa
cards.access_notes: Located at Campus Center; participation and facility access may require eligibility or current registration.

cards.title: Take a shaded break at the Art Building Breezeway
cards.subtitle: Near Campus Center
cards.notes: Bring a reading or low-key project to the shaded seating, and keep the breezeway clear for people moving through the building.
cards.short_summary: A shaded breezeway with seating near the Campus Center.
cards.evidence_claim: UH Mānoa’s College of Natural Sciences identifies the Art Building Breezeway near Campus Center as a shaded place with seating for a break or studying.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces — University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa College of Natural Sciences
cards.access_notes: Located by Campus Center; it is an open breezeway rather than a reservable room.

cards.title: Read outdoors in Sakamaki Hall Courtyard
cards.subtitle: Behind Kuykendall, inside Sakamaki Hall
cards.notes: Use the courtyard’s shaded seating for a quieter outdoor reset, and save weather-sensitive work for an indoor backup location.
cards.short_summary: A shaded courtyard with seating within Sakamaki Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: UH Mānoa’s College of Natural Sciences describes Sakamaki Courtyard as behind Kuykendall and inside Sakamaki Hall, with shade and seating.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces — University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa College of Natural Sciences
cards.access_notes: Located behind Kuykendall within Sakamaki Hall.

cards.title: Meet in Shidler Courtyard
cards.subtitle: Business Administration Building, Towers D and E
cards.notes: Use the shaded tables for an informal meeting or solo reading, then move inside if you need quiet, power, or a weather-proof setup.
cards.short_summary: A shaded seating area in the Business Administration Building complex.
cards.evidence_claim: UH Mānoa’s College of Natural Sciences places Shidler Courtyard at the Business Administration Building in front of Towers D and E and notes its shaded seating.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces — University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa College of Natural Sciences
cards.access_notes: At the Business Administration Building, in front of Towers D and E.

cards.title: Take a reading break at the Japanese Garden
cards.subtitle: Behind the East-West Center
cards.notes: Bring a blanket for a quiet outdoor pause on the grass; the university notes that the garden itself has no benches or tables.
cards.short_summary: A grassy garden space behind the East-West Center for an outdoor pause.
cards.evidence_claim: UH Mānoa’s College of Natural Sciences locates the Japanese Garden behind the East-West Center and notes that visitors can sit on the grass with a blanket.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces — University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa College of Natural Sciences
cards.access_notes: Behind the East-West Center; the university notes there are no benches or tables in the garden.
